script = Path("chart.py").read_text()
script = script.replace("go.Scatter(", "go.Bar(", 3)
script = script.replace("marker_color='#AB63FA'", "marker_color='#00CC96'")
script = script.replace("line=dict(color='#00CC96', width=3)", "line=dict(color='#AB63FA', width=3)")
script = script.replace("title='GDP Growth (%)',\n        side='left'", "title='Trade Balance (Billion USD)',\n        side='left'")
Path("chart.py").write_text(script)
exec(compile(script, "chart.py", "exec"))
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
for i, trace in enumerate(fig.data):
    assert list(trace.x) == table["Country"].tolist()
    assert list(trace.y) == table.iloc[:, i + 1].tolist()
print("Trace types:", [t.type for t in fig.data])
print("Colors:", [t.marker.color for t in fig.data[:3]], fig.data[3].line.color)
print("Axis titles:", fig.layout.yaxis.title.text, "/", fig.layout.yaxis2.title.text)
print("Bar mode:", fig.layout.barmode, "; GDP axis:", fig.data[3].yaxis)
